en: Sepia-toned postcard showing two women in traditional Romanian folk dress outdoors; one is breastfeeding a baby while the other stands beside her. A green Romanian 10 bani postage-due stamp is affixed and cancelled on the image. Handwritten message appears along the lower margin. The reverse bears Romanian handwriting, red publisher's imprint, and round postmarks dated 2 NOV 11.
